resources.string: Saved data could not be opened
The data saved on this phone could not be opened. This can happen after the phone was reset or restored. Try again, or reset the saved data and carry on. Your paper register is not affected.
This deletes everything saved on this phone, including research items that have not been sent yet. It cannot be undone.
Screening and research are turned off
NeoGold\'s own files did not pass a check on this phone. Install NeoGold again from the official source. Until then, use your facility\'s usual process.
This build was signed for development and cannot be used with babies. Install the release from the official source.
Some items could not be deleted
These could not be removed: %1$s. Restart the phone and try again.
